_comment: Page-weight ceilings: per reference page (scripts/bench/ref-pages.mjs), the most gzip and brotli bytes and requests its static request graph may have. Release-relative since #1985 step 3: each gzip and brotli number is the last release measured +5 percent and requests are exact, written only by node scripts/set-ceilings.mjs --release (--allow-page-weight button,form,table) in the release pull request; never edit by hand, never add a page to hide growth. If you are over inside a cycle, make the source smaller or load it lazily.
